hero.headline: The Executive Assistant that clears your mind.
hero.definition: TASKS  ·  CALENDAR  ·  IDEAS  ·  LISTS  ·  CUSTOM APPS

problem.title: The Universal Lie
body: We all carry a hidden weight. It's 2:00 PM. You are walking to your next meeting. In your head, you are juggling a grocery list, a breakthrough idea for a project, a worry about an email you sent, and the fact that you haven't drunk enough water today.
You could stop, pull out your phone, unlock it, open three different apps, and type it all out. But you don't. You say the Universal Lie: "I'll just remember that."
(You won't). And that mental clutter stays with you, stealing your focus.

solution.title: A Different Reflex
solution.body: Now, imagine a different reflex. Instead of carrying that weight, you just press the button on your watch (or phone). You don't curate your words. You don't look at a screen. You just speak.

demo.input: "Okay, remind me to call Sarah about the contract on Tuesday. Also, I'm feeling really overwhelmed by the house renovation, the noise is too much. Oh, and I just ran 5km in 25 minutes, feeling good."
demo.caption: It sounds messy. It sounds human. It sounds like you. Vois listens to the noise. But it saves the signal.

adapt.title: Your Life, Your Boxes
adapt.body: Need to track your headaches? Your meditation streaks? Your child's funny quotes? Just describe it. Vois builds a custom Space for it instantly. You don't build the system. You just live in it.

privacy.title: Your Mind, Your Control
privacy.body: Vois organizes your thoughts locally and securely. Nothing is finalized until you approve it. Nothing is shared. You are the only one with the key.
privacy.enterpriseBody: Your data is protected by the same infrastructure trusted by the world's largest companies. We use industry-leading services for reliability and security.

footer.headline: A clean mind. A structured life.
footer.subheadline: Stop doing the administrative work of your own existence. Give the chaos to Vois. Keep the clarity for yourself.

videoTransition.headline: Life doesn't wait for your notes app.
videoTransition.p1: Walking into the meeting. Standing in the shower. Halfway out the door.
videoTransition.p2: An invitation. A task. A thought you can't afford to lose.
videoTransition.p3: You tell yourself: "I'll just remember that."

retrieve.headline: Retrieve at the speed of sound.
retrieve.bodyAfter: . Your voice assistant finds exactly what you need from everything you've captured.

items.question: What's the difference between Personal and Work?
items.answer: Personal is for everyday life — capturing tasks, ideas, reminders, and notes. Work adds meeting transcription, action items, team collaboration tools, and priority support.

items.question: Is my voice data private?
items.answer: Yes. We use a local-first architecture. Your recordings are processed securely, and we do not use your personal thoughts to train our public models. Your brain is yours.

items.question: Can I switch plans or cancel anytime?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time. If you cancel, you'll keep access until the end of your current billing period.

items.question: What if it doesn't work for me?
items.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If Vois doesn't help you clear your mind in the first month, email us for a full refund.
